title: Klarna launches at Lakeland, bringing flexible payments to the UK’s highest-rated kitchenware brand | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**London, 25 November 2026 —** Klarna, the everyday finance network, is now available as a payment option at Lakeland, bringing shoppers at the UK’s highest-rated kitchenware brand* access to the country’s largest flexible payments provider.


Shoppers on Lakeland.co.uk can now pay with Klarna across Lakeland’s cookware, bakeware, electricals, cleaning and laundry ranges. They can choose to Pay in Full, Pay in 3 equal interest-free instalments or Pay Later, all with transparent terms and no revolving balance. The launch comes ahead of Black Friday and the Christmas shopping season.


“People deserve flexibility without paying interest for it, so our goal is simple: meet them wherever they shop,” said Alex Rohloff, Klarna Head of UK & Ireland. “For more than 60 years, Lakeland has been the go-to for clever kitchenware that makes everyday life easier. We’re proud to now offer its customers flexible payments, including a transparent way to spread the cost with no interest and a clear end date.”


Matthew Elliott, Head of Marketing at Lakeland, said: “We are delighted to launch Klarna on our website. At Lakeland, we want to make our creative kitchenware as accessible as possible, with trusted and flexible payment options like Klarna key to helping us achieve that.”


Founded in Windermere in 1964, Lakeland backs every product it sells with a 3-year guarantee, and Klarna is delighted to partner with a retailer so committed to its customers. Lakeland joins more than 1.3 million merchants globally that partner with Klarna.


*Based on Trustpilot average rating and review volume, Salience Search Marketing UK Kitchenware Report 2025.


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 122 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.3 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](http://klarna.com/)


.


**About Lakeland**
As one of the UK's home shopping pioneers with over 60 years of experience, Lakeland offer a fantastic collection of creative kitchenware, cleaning and laundry solutions to millions of customers both online and in store.


From humble beginnings in the heart of the Lake District, Lakeland now has 57 stores nationwide in the UK.


Lakeland’s dedication to exceptional products as well as customer satisfaction has set Lakeland apart from its competitors and provided their loyal customer following.


www.lakeland.co.uk


*GlobalData’s UK most trusted retailer ranking 2025
